verdict.rationale: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is India's statutory company registry, a government authority whose authoritative records cannot be self-hosted. Self-hosting is therefore a category error for this kind of product, not an unevidenced capability. The only evidence is two robots.txt 403 probes (mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in), which concern agent access and say nothing about self-hosting, so they do not bear on this verdict.
